messages.subject: NimbleHMC checkADsupportForDistribution error message
parts:
Hey everyone, 

I am trying to test out nimbleHMC but I have an error when building the MCMC. Here are more details. This is an example taken from the addHMC help file. 

library(nimble) # nimble version 1.1.0

library(nimbleHMC) # version 0.2.2

code <- nimbleCode({
  b0 ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)
  b1 ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)
  sigma ~ dunif(0, 10000)
  for(i in 1:N) {
    mu[i] <- b0 + b1 * x[i]
    y[i] ~ dnorm(mu[i], sd = sigma)
  }
})

N <- 10
constants <- list(N = N, x = 1:N)
data <- list(y = 1:N)
inits <- list(b0 = 1, b1 = 0.1, sigma = 1)

Rmodel <- nimbleModel(code, constants, data, inits, buildDerivs = TRUE)

## create default MCMC configuration object
conf <- configureMCMC(Rmodel)

## remove default samplers operating on b0 and b1
conf$removeSamplers(c("b0", "b1"))

## add an HMC sampler operating on b0 and b1
addHMC(conf, target = c("b0", "b1"))

Rmcmc <- buildMCMC(conf)

Everyting works nicely until the buildMCMC where I get the following error:
Error in envRefInferField(x, what, getClass(class(x)), selfEnv) : ‘checkADsupportForDistribution’ is not a valid field or method name for reference class “modelDefClass”. 

I maybe missing something quite simple but some help here would be much appreciated. 

Kind regards,
Fabian
